name: Swell VC
identity_check: Confirmed by domain swell.vc: New York pre-seed and seed fund; portfolio page lists Loft Orbital, Crisp, Deel, Credal. The 2024 PR Newswire release (Swell VC, Fund II) matches. Not Swell Partners-style aggregator entries of other firms, and not the fintech Swell that raised a $10M Series A. The lead of a $10M / 2022-08-31 fund close is not supported: the only fund sizes found are Fund II $11.5M (Oct 2024) and an unverified earlier $10M target.
